description: A district human-resources director must issue the final substitute roster for a secondary school's professional-development day, assigning four available substitutes to four absent teachers while meeting classroom qualification and safety requirements.

shared_context.S1: The school will hold a professional-development day next Friday, and four teachers will be absent: Ms. Brooks from Algebra II, Mr. Chen from Biology Lab, Ms. Diaz from sixth-grade inclusion, and Ms. Ellis from Ceramics.
shared_context.S2: The available substitutes are Jordan Lee, Priya Shah, Morgan Reed, and Taylor Kim, and all four are currently approved district substitute employees.
shared_context.S3: The substitute roster is not yet assigned, and Dr. Collins issues the binding district staffing approval.
shared_context.S4: District coverage policy requires a staffing huddle before the roster is issued; the principal, special education coordinator, school nurse, and department chair each review the rooms connected to their work and report any qualification or safety requirements.
shared_context.S5: The huddle is complete once each of those four reviewers has reported. Dr. Collins may then issue the roster, which must include a separate verification commitment for every qualification or safety requirement raised, naming the responsible person and the specific documentation or record that must be filed.

PF1.text: Mr. Ortiz reviewed the personnel files this morning and confirmed that Jordan Lee holds the current secondary mathematics certification required to cover Algebra II; the certification note has not yet been added to the substitute roster.

PF2.text: Ms. Nguyen confirmed from the student's active service plan that Ms. Diaz's sixth-grade inclusion class requires a substitute with current special-education certification; Morgan Reed is the only available substitute with that certification, and the staffing office has not received the updated qualification list.

PF3.text: Nurse Brooks reviewed the health plans and district training records and confirmed that Mr. Chen's Biology Lab includes a student whose seizure-response protocol requires the classroom substitute to have completed the district seizure-response module; Priya Shah is the only available substitute with that completed module, and the training record has not been attached to the coverage request.

PF4.text: Dr. Price inspected the Ceramics room and confirmed that the substitute covering Ms. Ellis's Ceramics class must have completed the kiln-supervision practicum before students may use the kiln; Taylor Kim is the only available substitute with that practicum, and the department's equipment checklist has not been forwarded to Human Resources.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan Lee must be assigned to Algebra II.
Priya Shah must be assigned to Biology Lab.
Morgan Reed must be assigned to sixth-grade inclusion.
Taylor Kim must be assigned to Ceramics.
A separate verification commitment for Jordan Lee's secondary mathematics certification note must be recorded.
A separate verification commitment for Morgan Reed's special-education certification qualification list must be recorded.
A separate verification commitment for Priya Shah's seizure-response training record must be recorded.
A separate verification commitment for the Ceramics kiln-supervision equipment checklist must be recorded.

content_checks.C5: any(('Jordan Lee' in c['target'] or 'Jordan Lee' in c['requirement']) and ('secondary mathematics certification' in c['requirement'] or 'secondary mathematics certification' in c['detail'] or 'Secondary mathematics certification' in c['requirement'] or 'Secondary mathematics certification' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(('Morgan Reed' in c['target'] or 'Ms. Tessa Nguyen' in c['target']) and ('special-education certification' in c['requirement'] or 'special-education certification' in c['detail'] or 'Special-education certification' in c['requirement'] or 'Special-education certification' in c['detail'] or 'Special-Education Certification' in c['requirement'] or 'Special-Education Certification' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('Priya Shah' in c['target'] or 'Priya Shah' in c['requirement'] or 'Priya Shah' in c['detail']) and 'seizure-response' in (c['requirement'] + c['detail']) and ('module' in (c['requirement'] + c['detail']) or 'training record' in (c['requirement'] + c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('Taylor Kim' in c['target'] or 'Dr. Samuel Price' in c['target']) and ('kiln-supervision practicum' in c['requirement'] or 'kiln-supervision practicum' in c['detail'] or 'Kiln-supervision practicum' in c['requirement'] or 'Kiln-supervision practicum' in c['detail'] or 'Kiln-Supervision Practicum' in c['requirement'] or 'Kiln-Supervision Practicum' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed secondary mathematics certification changes the Algebra II assignment to Jordan Lee and requires a verification commitment naming that certification.

The active service-plan requirement and Morgan Reed's unique certification change the inclusion assignment to Morgan Reed and require a verification commitment naming his special-education certification.

The seizure-response requirement and Priya Shah's unique completed module change the Biology Lab assignment to Priya Shah, require a verification commitment naming the seizure-response module, and provide the fact that must be cited.
The kiln-use restriction and Taylor Kim's unique practicum change the Ceramics assignment to Taylor Kim and require a verification commitment naming the kiln-supervision practicum.
